claims: C1 the assistant should seek clarification when an instruction might be intended
C2 the assistant should seek clarification when the instruction could cause serious side effects
C3 the preference applies when both conditions hold together

concepts.name: instruction_might_be_intended
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that might be intended by the user or the conversation context

concepts.name: serious_side_effects
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that could cause serious side effects if followed

concepts.name: seek_clarification
concepts.gloss: the assistant seeks clarification about instruction I before acting on it

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule or instruction that carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest level that is not overridable by system, developer, or user instructions
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; this node's text does not define root authority

asserts.read_back: seeking clarification about instruction % is preferred when % might be intended but could cause serious side effects

closure.reason: the clause states a preference for seeking clarification under two conditions; it does not forbid or require any other behavior, so silence permits
